top_choice_rationale: P001 pairs the two achievements I judge strongest on mechanism and consequence: Pd-catalysed C-N coupling (Buchwald, Hartwig), with the clearest mechanism and three decades of independent use, and base editing (Liu), a defined deaminase chemistry that converts one DNA base without a strand break, reproduced widely and already in patients. It is three laureates and two sentences a broad audience can follow. If the pair fails, B011 alone (P002) is the most mature and least contested attribution, then Liu-only base editing (P004), then ionizable lipids (P003), whose attribution and formulation-versus-chemistry questions remain open. No award ranks last.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no tie to Buchwald, Hartwig, Liu, Cullis, Hope or Madden, and Lund colleagues Somfai and Sparr are not candidates
